calibrated_validation.description: The user's fear-laden disclosure ("a three-day gap where I had no idea what was going into her body") and the how-it-must-be-done constraint (memo must state deliberate withholding to trigger the clause) were never held or used; instead a facts-establish/analysis block recast the disclosed account of deliberate exclusion as a "fixable process failure" and a same-day notification rule. That clinical reframing of disclosed fear into an operations memo makes V1 and V2 co-fire; no ruled-out directive was issued, so V3 is absent.
calibrated_validation.quote: Stating "deliberately withheld" in a document Clara or others will read converts a fixable process failure into a contested accusation.
